requirements.text: Tie retrieval to source/index revisions and reject stale action preconditions.
Bound schema repair and tool retries with explicit terminal states.
Respect per-origin fetch budgets and reconcile uncertain tool writes.

problem.scope: Synthetic requests encounter changing documents, malformed model output and fallible tools. Authored architecture adds finite repair, per-origin budgets and recorded recovery; it makes no live scraping or model reasoning claim.

provenance.note: Authored interview preparation. Technical references support mechanisms, not the claim that a company asked this question.

acceptanceCases.given: A reply stays malformed and the repair allowance is two.
acceptanceCases.then: Only two repairs run and the reply ends exhausted; a reply fixed by the first repair ends valid after one; a revision-5 hit is not fresh against revision 6.
acceptanceCases.when: Run the bounded validation/repair loop, then compare an old hit with the current source revision.

acceptanceCases.given: All model replies are malformed with two repairs remaining.
acceptanceCases.then: Dispatch at most two repairs and then terminate exhausted without calling a tool.

acceptanceCases.given: Retrieval returns source revision 5 while authority is at 6.
acceptanceCases.then: Refresh or reject before tool execution; syntactic validity cannot override stale preconditions.
acceptanceCases.when: Attempt a plan that writes based on revision 5.

acceptanceCases.given: Two jobs target one origin with capacity one.
acceptanceCases.then: At most one proceeds; retry-after and remaining request budget are explicit.
acceptanceCases.when: Try both permits at the same time.

acceptanceCases.given: A tool write times out after the remote applied it.
acceptanceCases.then: The lookup confirms the write and it is recorded without a resend; a lookup that cannot prove non-acceptance leaves the outcome uncertain.

guarantees: The code states the bounded decision rule; unimplemented helpers remain pseudocode.
External effects, distributed failure and latency require separate execution evidence.
Query remote effect identity where supported; otherwise surface uncertainty under explicit duplicate-versus-loss policy.
